name: Vahe Danielyan
bio:
Founder & CEO at KENTRON Real Estate Agency in Armenia · I'm Vahe Danielyan, the driving force behind KENTRON Real Estate, an agency I founded in 2005. In the past two decades, my journey has traversed the diverse landscape of Armenian real estate, helping clients navigate its complexities with ease. My comprehensive experience spans all property types - residential, commercial, urban - enabling me to provide diverse, well-informed solutions to our clients' varied needs.

At KENTRON, we prioritize client satisfaction above everything else. Leveraging my years of experience, and the collective knowledge of a passionate team, we aim to make your property journey seamless and rewarding. We've facilitated the realization of countless dreams - helping families find homes, entrepreneurs secure ideal business locations, and investors unlock significant opportunities.
